text:
alex: promo hold — build-packages-staging-412 failed pulling artifact: `GET https://artifacts.internal/models-2026-03-21.tar.gz -> 404`
deploy-bot: [automated] Promo hold applied to canary-2026-03-21. job=build-packages-staging-412 exit=1 reason=artifact-fetch-404
hugo: ugh. that artifact should be uploaded by the model-packager job. maybe GC ran and removed an untagged object?
nina: could be the index/regeneration race we saw on Fri. some uploads finish after the index checkpoint and don't get referenced.
ops: if it's just missing, the quick unblock is reuploading models-2026-03-21.tar.gz to artifacts.internal and marking it protected. who has upload creds?
ci-bot: helpful command: `gsutil cp models-2026-03-21.tar.gz gs://artifacts.internal/models/ && gsutil setmeta -h "x-goog-meta-protected:true" gs://artifacts.internal/models/models-2026-03-21.tar.gz && deploybot retry build-packages-staging-412`
alex: I have creds. can reupload now and tag. doing it.
(3m)
alex: run: `gsutil cp /tmp/models-2026-03-21.tar.gz gs://artifacts.internal/models/`
alex: run: `gsutil setmeta -h "x-goog-meta-protected:true" gs://artifacts.internal/models/models-2026-03-21.tar.gz`
ops: nice — metadata set. please also add an index entry so runners see it quickly: `curl -XPOST https://artifacts.internal/index/update -d '{"key":"models/models-2026-03-21.tar.gz"}'`
alex: posted index update. triggering retry: `deploybot retry build-packages-staging-412`
deploy-bot: retry queued for build-packages-staging-412. runner=ci-runner-07
ci-bot: build-packages-staging-412 started on ci-runner-07
ci-bot: fetching artifact -> 200 OK, checksum OK
ci-bot: unpacked models, build completed, exit=0
deploy-bot: canary promo resumed automatically after job success. Promo status: holding -> queued promote.
release-manager: proceed with canary promo at 16:05 UTC. leaving release note: transient artifact GC/index race removed untagged model bundle; we manually reuploaded and protected the object. follow-up: add uploader hook to set protected metadata and verify index registration before GC window.
hugo: filing ticket INF-500: uploader must set protected metadata and retry index registration; add alert when artifact index and bucket contents diverge.
nina: also adding short runbook to eng-releases: on artifact-fetch-404 during promo hold -> attempt reupload+setmeta+index-update, retry job; fallback: pin previous canary image if reupload impossible.\elease-manager: thanks all, mark resolved once promote completes :thumbsup:
